newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec to meet C$2.2 bln 97-98 deficit target.
newsitem.headline: Quebec to meet C$2.2 bln 97-98 deficit target.

text.p: Quebec will meet its budget deficit forecast of C$2.2 billion in fiscal 1997/98 the Canadian province's premier Lucien Bouchard said on Thursday.

Bouchard said the early retirement of 20,000 civil servants by July 1 would allow Quebec to save C$1.4 billion. The province made additional savings of C$800 million in fighting tax evasion and C$500 million in cutting transfers to municipalities, Bouchard said.
About C$900 million will be cut from government programs as well, he said.
Quebec forecast cuts of C$3.6 billion for 1997/98 in its last budget.

"Yes. It will happen. I am convinced we will meet our deficit target," Bouchard told a news conference. He restated aan earlier prediction that his government will have a zero deficit by April 1st, 1999.
"We can serenely affirm that the deficit of Quebeckers will be eliminated within the next 21 months," he said.
